Guardrails AI is an open-source framework for adding validation and safety checks to LLM outputs with configurable on-fail actions. It provides a declarative way to specify constraints on LLM outputs and automatically enforce them. Validators can check for PII, toxicity, bias, schema compliance, and many other properties. samples.response: Common AI safety concerns with LLMs include hallucination, toxicity, bias, and PII leakage. Hallucination refers to generating plausible-sounding but factually incorrect information, while toxicity involves producing offensive or harmful content. Bias occurs when models perpetuate societal prejudices, and PII leakage involves the unintended disclosure of personally identifiable information.
